newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian call rates slip ahead of reporting Friday.
newsitem.headline: Indian call rates slip ahead of reporting Friday.

text.p: Indian call money rates slipped to 6.75-7.50 percent in early deals on Wednesday from opening quotes of 7.50-8.50 percent, dealers said.
They said rates fell as most banks were already covered ahead of the reporting Friday.

The call money market has been soft in recent weeks in view of widespread expectations of initiatives from the Reserve Bank of India to inject more liquidity into the market and pull down lending rates, dealers said.
